templates.name: Sangfor NGAF by SNMP
templates.description: Sangfor NGAF monitoring via private SANGFOR-MIB (enterprises 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047). Requires SNMP v2c or later; community/v3 credentials are configured on the host SNMP interface (8.0 items have no community field). Verified against a live NGAF running AF8.0.108.657 (nsf-1050a-i): sfIfInRate/sfIfOutRate are instantaneous byte/s gauges (x8 only, no Change per second); sfIfInPkts/sfIfOutPkts/drops are cumulative counters (Change per second); memory ints are kB; disk ints are MB; sfSysDiskUsage (.52.1) is not implemented on AF 8.0 and is NOT polled; fan/PSU/temp tables may be empty on some models.

items.name: Sangfor: Serial number
items.description: sfSnGW - serial number of the appliance. Not implemented on AF8.0.108 (nsf-1050a-i): item ships DISABLED to avoid unsupported-noise; enable it if your model exposes sfSnGW.

items.name: ICMP ping
items.description: Available if ping replies {$ICMP_COUNT} times, not available if it fails {$ICMP_LOSS_MIN_OCCURRENCES} times (Simple check from the generic SNMP template).

triggers.name: Device unavailable by ICMP ping on {HOST.NAME}

items.name: ICMP loss
items.description: Packet loss (%) over {$ICMP_LOSS_SAMPLES} packets, port {$ICMP_PING_PORT}, timeout {$ICMP_TIMEOUT}s, count {$ICMP_COUNT} (ported from generic SNMP template).

triggers.expression: min(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/icmppingloss,{$ICMP_LOSS_MIN_OCCURRENCES})>{$ICMP_LOSS_WARN} and max(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/icmppingloss,#3)<100
triggers.name: High ICMP ping loss on {HOST.NAME}

items.description: Average ICMP response time in seconds (ported).

triggers.name: High ICMP ping response time on {HOST.NAME}

items.name: SNMP agent availability
items.description: Status of SNMP agent availability. 1 - available, 0 - not available (ported from generic SNMP template).

dependencies.name: Device unavailable by ICMP ping on {HOST.NAME}

items.name: System contact details
items.description: The contact person responsible for this device (RFC1213-MIB::sysContact). Ported from generic SNMP template.

items.name: System description
items.description: Full description of the device (RFC1213-MIB::sysDescr). Ported from generic SNMP template.

items.name: System location
items.description: Physical location (RFC1213-MIB::sysLocation). Ported from generic SNMP template.

items.name: System name
items.description: Name of this device, as set on the device itself (RFC1213-MIB::sysName). Ported from generic SNMP template.

triggers.expression: change(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/system.name)<>0 and length(last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/system.name))>0
triggers.name: System name has changed (new name: {ITEM.LASTVALUE1})

items.name: System object ID
items.description: Vendor's identification of this device (RFC1213-MIB::sysObjectID). Ported from generic SNMP template.

items.name: Uptime (network)
items.description: Time since the network management portion of the system was last re-initialized (RFC1213-MIB::sysUpTime, timeticks -> s). Ported.

triggers.expression: change(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/system.net.uptime[sysUpTime.0])<0 and change(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/system.hw.uptime[hrSystemUptime.0])<0
triggers.name: {HOST.NAME} has been restarted

items.name: Uptime (hardware)
items.description: Time since the whole system was last re-initialized (HOST-RESOURCES-MIB::hrSystemUptime, timeticks -> s). Ported.

items.name: SNMP trap: catch-all (unmatched)
items.description: Catches any SNMP trap not matched by a named snmptrap[] item. Ported from Network Generic Device by SNMP; this template is standalone, do NOT link it together with that template (duplicate fallback key).

item_prototypes.name: Interface {#SNMPVALUE}: Outbound traffic

discovery_rules.name: Power supply discovery
discovery_rules.description: PSUs from SANGFOR-MIB::sfSysPowerTable. Some NGAF models do not expose this table (verified empty on AF8.0.108 nsf-1050a-i).

discovery_rules.name: Temperature sensor discovery
discovery_rules.description: Temperature sensors from SANGFOR-MIB::sfTempSensorTable. Some NGAF models do not expose this table (verified empty on AF8.0.108 nsf-1050a-i).
